meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析、比较与注释进化树
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果处理系统发育数据并需要比较树结构。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze, compare, and annotate phylogenetic trees.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with phylogenetic data and need to compare tree topologies.

howto.what: Claude 可以读取、修改、比较和可视化系统发育树(树状分支图),支持 Newick 等格式;能进行拓扑编辑、计算 Robinson-Foulds 距离、检测基因树的复制与分化事件、查询 NCBI 分类,并输出 PDF/SVG 图片。
howto.when: 当用户要求读取、编辑或比较树文件(如 Newick/Nexus),检测基因树事件,或查询 NCBI 分类并可视化时触发;不会用于从原始序列直接推断树。

比较 tree1.nw 和 tree2.nw 的拓扑差异
say.note: 给出 Robinson-Foulds 距离和独有分区。

say.text: 把 gene_tree.nw 画成 PDF,节点按支持度着色
say.note: 生成带样式的树图文件。

howto.what_en: Claude can read, edit, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic trees with ETE 4: Newick/NHX/PhyloXML/NeXML I/O, topology edits, Robinson-Foulds distances, gene-tree duplication/speciation detection, NCBI taxonomy lookups, and PDF/SVG rendering.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to load, edit, compare, or visualize existing tree files (e.g., Newick/Nexus), detect gene-tree duplication/speciation events, or query NCBI taxonomy. Not for inferring trees from raw sequences.

say_en.text: Read tree.nw and report leaf and node counts.
Compare tree1.nw and tree2.nw for topological differences.
say_en.note: Gives Robinson-Foulds distance and unique partitions.

say_en.text: Render gene_tree.nw as PDF, coloring nodes by support.
